pairs.difference: A Frog is smooth, wet and a jumper; a Toad is dry, bumpy and a walker.
An Eagle hunts live prey and is a symbol of power; a Vulture has a bald head and eats dead animals.
A Butterfly is colourful and flies by day; a Moth is dull, flies at night and is drawn to lights.
A Leopard has rosette spots, climbs trees and is stocky; a Cheetah has solid spots, tear lines and is the fastest runner.
An Ant is the busy insect that marches in lines to sugar; a Termite is a pale insect that eats wood and furniture.
A Bee is fuzzy and makes honey; a Wasp is smooth, thin-waisted and more aggressive.
A Donkey is a species of its own; a Mule is a cross between a donkey and a horse.
A Mosquito bites, whines at night and spreads dengue; a Housefly sits on food and buzzes by day.
A Pigeon is grey, plump and coos on balconies; a Crow is black, caws loudly and is clever.
A Sheep is woolly and follows the flock; a Goat has a beard and horns, and climbs and eats anything.
Both are sea creatures with many legs. An Octopus is soft, with eight arms and ink; a Crab has a hard shell and claws, and walks sideways.
A Dog is a pet that lives at home; a Wolf is wild and lives and hunts in packs.
A Lion has a mane and lives in prides; a Tiger has stripes and lives alone.
A Horse is ridden and comes in plain colours; a Zebra is wild and striped.
An Elephant has a trunk and big ears; a Rhino has a horn on its nose.
A Shark is a fish with gills and is feared; a Dolphin is a mammal that breathes air and is friendly.
A Monkey is small with a tail; a Gorilla is huge, has no tail and beats its chest.
A Snake has no legs; a Lizard has four legs and climbs walls.
An Owl is a bird with feathers; a Bat is a mammal with leathery wings that hangs upside down.
A Duck is small and quacks; a Swan is large and white, with a long curved neck.
A Cow is usually light-coloured; a Buffalo is black, has big curved horns and wallows in mud.
A Cat is the hunter; a Mouse is the hunted.
Both are flightless birds. A Penguin swims in the cold; an Ostrich runs in the heat.
A Fox is a sly orange hunter; a Rabbit is a soft, long-eared animal that hops and eats carrots.
Both are Australian. A Kangaroo hops; a Koala sleeps in trees.
A Peacock is the national bird and fans its tail; a Parrot is green and talks.
A Snail carries a shell; an Earthworm is bare and lives underground.
A Goldfish is a pet in a bowl; a Jellyfish is see-through, lives in the sea and stings.
A Panda is black-and-white and eats bamboo; a Polar Bear is white and lives on the ice.
